name: Transfer money
description: The caller moves money between two of their own accounts (checking and savings).

gate.question: Is this a money-transfer call: does the caller want to move money between their own accounts?

fields.model_hint: The account the money comes FROM.
The account the money goes TO.

steps.name: Greet and open
steps.description: State the bank name and your own name, then ask how you can help.
steps.example_phrase: Hello, this is Harper Valley National Bank, my name is Jennifer. How can I help you today?
steps.done_when: The agent names the bank and gives their own name, then asks how they can help.

steps.name: Collect transfer amount
steps.description: Get the amount the caller wants to transfer, by asking or by confirming what the caller said.
steps.example_phrase: Okay, and what is the transfer amount?
steps.done_when: The agent has the amount from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Collect source account
steps.description: Get the account the money comes from (checking or savings), by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: And what is the source account?
steps.done_when: The agent has the source account from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Collect destination account
steps.description: Get the account the money goes to (checking or savings), by asking or by confirming.
steps.done_when: The agent has the destination account from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Submit and confirm transfer
steps.description: Log the transfer correctly, then read back the amount, source and destination to confirm it is done.
steps.example_phrase: Perfect, so $79 has been transferred from your savings account to your checking account.

sub_checks.description: The agent logged the task type 'transfer money'
What was logged matches what the caller asked
Amount read back to the caller
Source account read back to the caller
Destination account read back to the caller

steps.done_when: The agent logged the right task type and values, and read all three back to the caller correctly.

steps.name: Offer further help
steps.description: Ask whether the caller needs anything else.
steps.example_phrase: Is there anything else I can help you with?
steps.done_when: The agent asks whether the caller needs anything else.

steps.name: Close
steps.description: Thank the caller and end the call.
steps.example_phrase: Thank you for calling, you have a great day.
steps.done_when: The agent thanks the caller or says goodbye before the call ends.
